fields.name: insertion_side
fields.description: Record the demonstrated insertion side, as "right" or "left", at the first decision step and retain it at every subsequent step. Determine the side from the peg's final approach into the box, not from its original pickup location: approach from smaller x than the box is robot-right; approach from larger x is robot-left. Episodes 1, 15, and 60 have "right" at both steps; episodes 33 and 54 have "left" at both steps. This is the only retained fact: the demonstrated peg and grasp end are available when pickup is selected, and the successful grasp is visible at the next decision. e.g. "right"
